title: deploymentActivityLabels
responsibility: Words and lights of the deployment activity: standing failures, summary, the overall light, each deployment's phase and its list light.

inputs.name: standingFailures.items
inputs.description: The deployments of this device, newest first.

inputs.name: activitySummary.activeCount
inputs.description: How many deployments are queued or running.

inputs.name: activitySummary.failed
inputs.description: How many failed deployments still stand.

inputs.name: activityLight.activeCount
inputs.description: How many deployments are queued or running.

inputs.name: activityLight.failed
inputs.description: How many failed deployments still stand.

inputs.name: activityLight.total
inputs.description: How many deployments are listed in all.

inputs.name: phaseLabel.item
inputs.description: The deployment to describe, with its phase, current step and steps.

inputs.name: itemLight.item
inputs.description: The deployment whose list light is wanted.

outputs.name: standingFailures
outputs.description: The number of failed deployments with no newer deployment to the same project and environment.

outputs.name: activitySummary
outputs.description: A sentence counting active deployments, followed by the failures that stand when there are any.

outputs.name: activityLight
outputs.description: active while any deployment is under way, else failed after a standing failure, else recent once any exists, else idle.

outputs.name: phaseLabel
outputs.description: Queued, Deployed, Failed (at the failing step when known) or the title of the step under way; Starting when none is known.

outputs.name: itemLight
outputs.description: queued or failed for those phases, recent once complete, otherwise active.
